ai/npc/Teleports/ElrokiTeleporters/32112.text: Gariachin: Oh, no! This is not good, not good at all. My sincerest apologies -- I cannot tell you what happened in detail -- but I cannot teleport you to your destination at the moment. I'm terribly sorry for the inconvenience.

Gariachin: Welcome! I am Gariachin. I am entrusted with the teleportation of visitors to this island. It may sound strange to you, but I've come to love this island and respect its people.
